name: UGC Problem / Solution
description: Same cast-and-anchor approach as the talking head, but the person moves through their space instead of sitting still: cold-open on the pain, turn on the product, close on the relief. Framing and setting change between beats while the face stays fixed, so it reads as a story rather than three takes of one shot.

pain.description: The specific frustration the viewer already feels, in their own words.

turn.description: The moment the product changes the situation.

value.frame: Shot on an iPhone, handheld, vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural slight unevenness, faint freckles, natural skin sheen, no beauty filter, no airbrushing. Natural window light with soft uneven shadows, available room light only. Casual clothing with real wrinkles. Lived-in cluttered setting with specific everyday objects. Slightly imperfect off-centre framing, mild phone-lens distortion, subtle grain. Candid unposed moment, authentic amateur phone photo.
value.motion: Keep the exact same person, hair, wardrobe and setting as the reference image. Handheld phone camera feel, slight unsteady framing. Natural micro-movements: blinking, breathing, small shifts of weight, fabric moving. Continuous authentic phone footage, no cuts.
value.negative: studio lighting, perfect symmetry, cinematic colour grade, airbrushed skin, plastic skin, waxy skin, beauty filter, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, polished commercial look, watermark, text overlay, subtitles, extra fingers, warped hands

nodes.system: You cast and direct short-form UGC video. You write people who look like real customers filming themselves, never like models in an advert. You are specific and grounded, and you write dialogue how people actually talk — contractions, short sentences, one idea per line.

schema.actor: one paragraph pinning down age, build, hair, face, exact clothing and the specific place
schema.master_frame_prompt: still-image prompt for the establishing frame

shots.frame_prompt: edit instruction from the master frame
shots.motion_prompt: action and delivery, with the spoken line in quotes
